---
title: "ہَلو مومنو ہَلو کربلا"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
reciter: "Anjuman Gulzar-e-Haidry (Nadeem Sarwar)"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false

Hussain
Halo momino halo Karbala

1
Manzoor kai Zahra dua
Razi nabbi razi khuda

2
Manzoor kai Zahra dua
Razi nabbi razi khuda

3
Aey momino tayyar theyo manzoor the pehnji dua
Ibn-e-alia ja aashiqo gadh ji kayo shukr-e-khuda
Moula naseeban main likhi zawwari-e-shah-e-huda

4
Manzoor kai Zahra dua
Razi nabbi razi khuda

5
Khuld-e-bareen aa Karbala sardar aa moula hussain
In khoobsoorat baagh jo singhaar aa moula hussain
Karbal main zawwaran mathaa rehmat wasey the ja ba ja

6
Manzoor kai Zahra dua
Razi nabbi razi khuda

7
Moulaiyo in maa ayan touqeer aa abbas ji
Hi Karbala ji sar zameen jageer aa abbas ji
Aa hey awaan jo muntazir ghazi alamdar-e-wafa

8
Manzoor kai Zahra dua
Razi nabbi razi khuda

9
Shabbira ja zawwar thee arshia chan farshia chan
Mazlooma ja sabh matami khak-e-shifa khey ta chuman
Hoor o malak jin o bashar sabh noukari kan tha adaa

10
Manzoor kai Zahra dua
Razi nabbi razi khuda

11
Karbobala tey momino ehsaan aa shabbira jo
Ohna jaaey tey sajdo kayo moula jithey sajdo kayo
Manzil asaan ji Karbala
Hee aa asaan ji darsgaah

12
Manzoor kai Zahra dua
Razi nabbi razi khuda

13
Jawwad sarwar jaa okhey Zainab kithey rooi saggi
Mazloomaan jey laashey wata chup chaap the guzri waai
Ohna jaae tey kariyo halli
Shabbira jo matam bapa

14
Manzoor kai Zahra dua
Razi nabbi razi khuda

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/hlo-momno-hlo-karbala.md')
_, metadata, roman = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = roman.strip('\\n')
metadata = metadata.replace('language: \"Urdu\"', 'alternateTitle: \"Halo Momino Halo Karbala\"\\nlanguage: \"Sindhi\"').replace('lang: \"ur\"', 'lang: \"sd\"').replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"').replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]', 'tags: []')
refrain = 'منظور ڪئي زهرا دعا\\nراضي نبي راضي خدا'
source = {
    3: \"\"\"اي مومنو تيار ٿيو منظور ٿي پنهنجي دعا
ابنِ عليءَ جا عاشقو گڏجي ڪريو شڪرِ خدا
مولا نصيبن ۾ لکي زواريِ شاهِ هدا\"\"\",
    5: \"\"\"خلدِ برين آ ڪربلا سردار آ مولا حسين
هن خوبصورت باغ جو سينگار آ مولا حسين
ڪربل ۾ زوارن مٿان رحمت وسي ٿي جا بجا\"\"\",
    7: \"\"\"مولائيو هن ۾ اڃان توقير آ عباس جي
هي ڪربلا جي سرزمين جاگير آ عباس جي
آهي اوهان جو منتظر غازي علمدارِ وفا\"\"\",
    9: \"\"\"شبير جا زوار ٿي عرشي اچن فرشي اچن
مظلوم جا سڀ ماتمي خاڪِ شفا کي ٿا چمن
حور و ملڪ جن و بشر سڀ نوڪري ڪن ٿا ادا\"\"\",
    11: \"\"\"ڪرب و بلا تي مومنو احسان آ شبير جو
ان جاءِ تي سجدو ڪريو مولا جتي سجدو ڪيو
منزل اسان جي ڪربلا
هيءَ آ اسان جي درسگاهه\"\"\",
    13: \"\"\"جواد سرور جا اوکي زينب ڪٿي روئي سگهي
مظلوم جي لاشي وٽان چپ چاپ ٿي گذري وئي
ان جاءِ تي ڪجو هلي
شبير جو ماتم بپا\"\"\",
}
blocks = roman.split('\\n\\n')
body = ['حسين\\nهلو مومنو هلو ڪربلا']
for block in blocks[1:]:
    number, *verses = block.splitlines()
    stanza = source.get(int(number), refrain)
    assert len(stanza.splitlines()) == len(verses)
    body.append(number.translate(str.maketrans('0123456789', '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹')) + '\\n' + stanza)
roman_yaml = '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in roman.splitlines())
p.write_text('---' + metadata.replace('title: \"ہَلو مومنو ہَلو کربلا\"', 'title: \"هلو مومنو هلو ڪربلا\"') + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman_yaml + '\\n---\\n\\n' + '\\n\\n'.join(body) + '\\n')
PY
git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/hlo-momno-hlo-karbala.md"

item.text:
Reconstructed the source-script body in [hlo-momno-hlo-karbala.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/1/workspaces/99393211dad344e0be9b70835db3175a/src/data/lyrics/hlo-momno-hlo-karbala.md) and preserved the complete Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`, including the opening and all 14 numbered stanzas.

The verse grammar identifies the kalam as Sindhi, so I set the metadata to Sindhi (`sd`, `rtl`) and removed the missing-source tag. I read the ambiguous `arshia chan farshia chan` as `عرشي اچن فرشي اچن` and retained `Jawwad` as `جواد`. Only the selected file was edited.
